card.name: The end of dialysis in overdose text
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'dialysis' or 'hemodialysis' in sentences saying a drug is or is not removed by dialysis. It also fires weakly on 'only' in 'used during pregnancy only if'.

modes.label: Dialysis removal
modes.description: The ending 'ysis' of dialysis or hemodialysis after 'removed by' in overdosage statements.
modes.example: Valsartan is not removed from the plasma by dial<<ysis>>.

modes.label: Pregnancy 'only'
modes.description: The word 'only' after 'during pregnancy' in the phrase 'should be used during pregnancy only if'.
modes.example: Amitriptyline hydrochloride should be used during pregnancy<< only>> if the potential benefit to the mother just
